Organic spice blends

An organic spice blend is a mix of whole spices that are roasted and ground together in small batches so the flavour stays fresh for longer.

What is in our garam masala blend?

Our garam masala combines cumin, coriander, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves and black pepper, roasted at low heat for 12 minutes and ground within 24 hours of packing.

How to store spice blends at home

  1. Keep the jar closed and away from sunlight.
  2. Use a dry spoon every time.
  3. Finish the jar within 6 months.

Why choose small-batch grinding over factory blends

Small batches keep volatile oils intact. A 2024 study from FSSAI found that 85% of aroma compounds survive when spices are ground within 48 hours.
